message:
Summary: USER_CONTEXT: Fix OSS-Fuzz MSAN use-of-uninitialized-value crash in AAT::LookupFormat0::get_value during NoncontextualSubtable::apply. The crash occurs when a truncated font file passes sanitize checks but get_value returns a pointer to uninitialized memory within the blob.

COMPLETED:
- Traced the crash path: NoncontextualSubtable::apply → substitute.get_value(info[i].codepoint, num_glyphs) → LookupFormat0::get_value returns &arrayZ[glyph_id]
- Verified both sanitize and apply use the same num_glyphs from face->get_num_glyphs() (no mismatch)
- Examined UnsizedArrayOf::sanitize → sanitize_shallow → check_array → check_range which validates array bounds
- Examined LookupFormat0::sanitize (line 164) which calls arrayZ.sanitize(c, c->get_num_glyphs())
- Examined LookupFormat0::get_value which checks glyph_id >= num_glyphs before returning &arrayZ[glyph_id]
- Confirmed the vulnerability: sanitize validates array has num_glyphs entries, but if the blob is truncated shorter than num_glyphs * sizeof(T), get_value returns pointer to uninitialized memory

PENDING:
- Determine exact root cause: how can sanitize pass when blob is too short? (check_array should catch truncation)
- Create proof-of-concept font file that triggers the crash
- Develop fix (likely need bounds checking in get_value or additional sanitize validation)

CURRENT_STATE:
- Crash: Use-of-uninitialized-value in AAT::LookupFormat0<OT::IntType<unsigned short, 2u>>::get_value
- Fuzzer: hb-shape-fuzzer (libFuzzer with MSAN)
- Key files examined: hb-aat-layout-morx-table.hh, hb-aat-layout-common.hh, hb-machinery.hh, hb-open-type.hh, hb-face.hh, hb-static.cc, hb-ot-maxp-table.hh

- File: /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/harfbuzz/src/hb-aat-layout-common.hh (lines 354-393): Lookup::get_value and sanitize
